resources.string: Find practical instructions for catalogs, playback, your library, downloads, and settings. This guide is stored in the app and works offline.
Getting started
Connect a catalog source
Install a provider extension, then choose it as the source for Explore and Catalogs.
provider, extension, repository, source, add catalog, install

string-array.name: auras_help_connect_steps
string-array.item: Open Settings, then Extensions & Sources.
Add a trusted repository if you do not already have one.
Open Browse Plugins, choose a repository, and install a provider that supports the media you want.
Return to Explore. Use the source control at the top to select the provider, then open Catalogs.

resources.string: If no source appears, check that its provider extension is installed and enabled. Repositories list extensions; adding a repository does not install its providers.
Explore and catalogs
Browse Catalogs and use More
Browse shelves from the selected provider and load the next page into the same shelf.
more, load more, pagination, next page, catalog list, provider catalog, retry

string-array.name: auras_help_catalogs_steps
string-array.item: Open Catalogs from Explore and select the source that provides the shelves you want.
Scroll to a shelf and tap More. The next provider page is appended to that same shelf; it does not open a separate drawer.
While the request runs, the action shows Loading. Tap Retry if the provider returns an error.
Repeat while More is available. The action disappears after the provider confirms there are no more pages.

resources.string: A page request needs a working connection and a provider that supports more pages. On an error, the existing titles stay visible and Retry remains available. Changing source clears the old shelves before loading the new source.
Explore Top 10 and Trending shelves
Understand the Explore screen\'s ten-title Top 10 presentation and provider-based popular shelves.
top ten, top 10, trending, popular, ranking, explore, limit

string-array.name: auras_help_topten_steps
string-array.item: Explore may show a Top 10 shelf with at most ten titles. This is the intended Top 10 presentation.
Popular or Trending content depends on the connected provider\'s response. Auras does not combine providers into a global ranking.
Open Catalogs to browse the provider\'s shelves. Use More there when you want additional pages from a catalog.
Use the source control to change which provider supplies Explore and Catalogs content.

resources.string: A provider may not supply a Top 10, Popular, or Trending shelf. If it is missing, choose another provider or browse its Catalogs shelves.
People and credits
About and credits
Browse a cast member\'s filmography
Open a person from a title\'s cast, browse their movie and TV credits, and look up a selected credit in installed providers.
actor, cast, crew, voice actor, person, filmography, credits, movies, tv

string-array.name: auras_help_people_steps
string-array.item: Open a title and select an actor name or portrait in its cast row. The card tap still flips between actor and voice actor portraits.
If TMDB finds more than one person with that name, choose the matching person from the candidate list.
Use All, Movies, or TV to filter credits. Enter a title or role in the filter field to narrow the list.
Select a credit to search installed providers for a matching title. Open a provider result to continue to that title\'s details.

resources.string: A person match and filmography require an internet connection and TMDB data. Provider matches depend on installed providers and their search catalogs; a TMDB credit alone is not a playable source.
TMDB data and credits
Person profiles and filmography are supplied by The Movie Database (TMDB).
tmdb, the movie database, credits, attribution, data source

string-array.name: auras_help_tmdb_steps
string-array.item: TMDB supplies cast-person matches, profile details, images, and movie and TV credits shown by the person browser.
Provider search results come from installed Auras Orbit providers. TMDB credits do not imply that a title is available to stream.
Open themoviedb.org to view its source data and API information.

resources.string: This product uses the TMDB API but is not endorsed or certified by TMDB.
This product uses the TMDB API but is not endorsed or certified by TMDB. TMDB data and images are provided by The Movie Database.
The Movie Database TMDB logo
Search for a title
Search available providers and open a matching result.
find, lookup, title, show, movie, query, results

string-array.name: auras_help_search_steps
string-array.item: Open Search from the navigation bar.
Enter a title and submit the search. If provider selection is available, choose which installed providers to search.
Review the result name and provider, then open a result to see its details.

resources.string: Results depend on installed providers and their catalogs. Check your provider selection, try a shorter search, or browse Explore and Catalogs.
Open details and start playback
Review a title, choose an episode when needed, and start an available stream.
details, episode, season, play, resume, stream, source, server

string-array.name: auras_help_titleplay_steps
string-array.item: Open a title from Search, Explore, Catalogs, or your Library.
Review the provider and available details. For a series, select a season and episode.
Tap Play or Resume and wait for available sources to load.
If one source fails, return to source selection and try another available source or provider.

resources.string: A title may have no playable sources from the selected provider. Check the connection, try another source, or open the same title from another provider.
Choose audio and subtitles
Select tracks and adjust subtitle presentation using the controls available for the stream.
captions, subtitles, language, audio track, synchronization, timing

string-array.name: auras_help_audio_steps
string-array.item: Open the player controls while a video is playing.
Open Audio or Subtitles and choose a listed track. Track names and languages depend on the stream.
Use the offered timing or style controls to adjust subtitles. Reopen the panel to change or turn off a track.

resources.string: If a language is missing, the stream may not contain that track. Try another source. Subtitle search also needs a network connection and matching results.
Use Library and watch history
Save titles, change watch status, and resume from saved playback history.
bookmark, watchlist, saved, completed, watching, history, continue

string-array.name: auras_help_library_steps
string-array.item: Open a title\'s details and use its Library action to save it or choose a watch status.
Open Library to find saved titles. Use available tabs, search, and filters to narrow the list.
Open Watch History or a Continue Watching item to resume from saved progress.
Use Clear All in Watch History only when you intend to remove saved resume progress.

resources.string: Library bookmarks and watch history are different. Removing a bookmark does not necessarily clear playback history, and clearing history does not remove bookmarks.
Manage downloads
Queue supported episodes and manage active or completed downloads.
offline, save, download, queue, storage, delete, local file

string-array.name: auras_help_downloads_steps
string-array.item: Open a title and choose an episode with a download action.
Choose an offered quality and review the transfer in Downloads.
Use the available pause, resume, cancel, or delete actions to manage the item.
Open a completed download from Downloads to play it locally.

resources.string: Downloads depend on the provider and available device storage. If a transfer fails, check the network and free space, then retry from Downloads.
Settings and recovery
Find a setting or get help
Open app settings, search this manual, and collect useful details for a problem report.
preferences, options, manual, support, bug, error, report

string-array.name: auras_help_settings_steps
string-array.item: Open Settings from the navigation bar and choose a settings group.
Open Help & Manual from Settings or the help icon on Explore and Catalogs.
Search by a screen name, task, or related word. This manual works offline.
For a problem report, note the app version, screen, steps, expected result, actual result, provider, and visible error.

resources.string: Do not include passwords, tokens, private profile data, or private watch history in a problem report. For accessibility issues, include the device, TalkBack or remote-control action, screen, and control where you became stuck.
